verdict.rationale: Deel exposes payroll, contracts, and people data via REST API and an official MCP server that AI agents (Claude, ChatGPT, custom agents) can call, plus webhooks for real-time events — giving an agent a path to pull payroll data programmatically. However, there is no evidence of a dedicated 'payroll journal' export/report or built-in reconciliation-to-ledger functionality (e.g., mapping to GL codes or accounting-system sync); it only shows generic payroll/contract/time data endpoints and MCP tools like listOfContracts and createTimeOffRequest. missing for 10: explicit payroll journal/GL export format, evidence of ledger reconciliation logic or accounting-system integration (QuickBooks/Xero/etc.), and independent confirmation of an agent successfully performing this reconciliation workflow.
